title: Zacks Industry Outlook Applied Materials, Lam Research and FormFactor
author: Zacks Equity Research
description: The semiconductor industry is experiencing strong growth driven by AI demand expanding beyond model training into inference and physical AI, requiring advanced chips across logic, DRAM, NAND, and HBM. Applied Materials, Lam Research, and FormFactor are well-positioned to benefit from increased hyperscaler spending on AI-supportive chips and advanced packaging. However, the industry faces headwinds from supply chain constraints, rising manufacturing costs, and potential tariffs.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) with strong positioning in leading-edge foundry-logic, DRAM, and advanced packaging. Advanced packaging revenues expected to grow over 70% in 2026, supported by AI-driven HBM and chiplet demand. Stock appreciated 111% year-to-date with earnings estimates increased.

Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) benefiting from manufacturing complexity trends and AI workloads driving NAND storage requirements. Advanced packaging business expected to grow over 70% year-over-year. Stock appreciated 102% year-to-date with steady earnings estimates.

Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) gaining from probe card demand tied to HPC and advanced packaging. AI chiplet architectures increasing testing and probe card spending. Stock appreciated 164.6% year-to-date with structural tailwinds expected to accelerate from 2027.

title: Buy 5 Growth Stocks to Boost Your Portfolio in Q4 After a Mixed Q3

title: Micron Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Pricing and AI Demand
author: Na
description: Micron Technology reported record Q4 fiscal 2026 revenues of $54.23B with earnings surging 11-fold to $33.42 per share, driven by strong AI demand and tight memory/storage pricing. title: Should Investors Bet on Diodes After the ElevATE Acquisition?
author: Na
description: Diodes Incorporated completed a $250 million acquisition of ElevATE Semiconductor to strengthen its position in the automated test equipment market. ElevATE is expected to contribute $50M in revenue within the first 12 months and deliver over 20% annual revenue growth thereafter. The deal adds higher-margin analog and mixed-signal products to Diodes' portfolio, supporting margin recovery amid improving demand in automotive, computing, and industrial sectors.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strategic acquisition expands high-margin product portfolio and ATE market exposure. Q2 2026 showed strong 21.7% revenue growth with margin expansion. Expected to be immediately accretive to revenues, gross margin, and EPS. Positioned to achieve long-term targets of $2B annual revenue and $4+ non-GAAP EPS.
